capabilities: Copy selected File Explorer files and folders as FileDrop clipboard objects
Restore normal text copying when focus leaves the File Explorer
Skip selected descendants when a parent folder is copied
Invoke powershell.exe to place vault paths on the Windows clipboard
disambiguation: Not a general clipboard manager; it only redefines Ctrl+C inside the File Explorer, leaving editor and other views untouched.
extras: Windows-only and desktop-only; it reads the File Explorer's internal selection state, which the author says should be retested after major Obsidian upgrades. No network services or telemetry.
intentEvidence: changes Ctrl+C in the focused File Explorer into a native Windows file copy
problem: Copying from Obsidian's File Explorer does not put actual file objects on the Windows clipboard, so other apps cannot receive the selected vault files directly as attachments.
summary: Windows-only plugin that turns Ctrl+C in the File Explorer into a native file copy, placing selected files and folders on the Windows file-drop clipboard.
